title: Incendosaur

[[Image:Incendosaur.jpg|right|frame|Incendosaur]]
The [[Incendosaur]]s are a species of large crimson reptiles that reside deep underground in [[Slag Pit|the Slag Pit]] in [[Searing Gorge]]. Their [[Incendosaur Scales|scales]] are highly sought after by the [[Dark Iron dwarf|Dark Iron Dwarves]] as a constituent in creating '[[Fiery Flux]]'.
